posts.name: Bhuvanya
posts.cooked: my laptop table got damaged and i had to replace it with another table, THE ROOM IS SAME BUT THE LAYOUT IS DIFFERENT. i have sc oppe in this term. WHAT TO DO??

posts.name: HIMANSHU GUPTA
posts.cooked:
No problem, system compatibility test is only associated with checking view angle of camera for oppe gmeet and it also check your laptop meet minimum requirements or not.

Even I also change my table and room sometimes.

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked: I would suggest, please do the SCT, with another laptop.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you have received a mail stating SCT to be done mandatorily then yes you have to do it. Otherwise, if it’s optional it doesn’t matter whether the room layout or the place changes as long as you have proper angle.

posts.name: Anant
posts.cooked:
So, I got a mail from IITM that SCT is optional for me as I had given SCT for Python in my previous term. On my dashboard, I can see OPEE approval : 1 for all courses except System Commands, and I also haven’t received any Google Meet link for SCT. So, do I have to give SCT for System Commands? If yes, how, since I am not getting any email with the Meet link?

image1514×495 83.7 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Please check older posts before creating new ones. If the mail says optional, it is not mandatory. There is no separate SCT for every course. It’s just one SCT. The approval will be updated for SC later.

posts.name: Vignesh
posts.cooked: Hi In my dashboard for oppe sct it shows 0 so it means I am fail I guess when will the second sct window will be started .

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Please mail to support regarding this. @25dp1000034
